notes:
Company snapshot: Conversant Agents is a mid-market multi-tenant SaaS platform providing conversational agents for customer support and workflows. Evaluating Redwood for inference (hosted API first, then Dedicated for predictable throughput).

Recent cadence and timeline:
- 2026-01-20: Intro demo with Jordan (AE) + Priya (SE). Showed hosted API flow, streaming, function/tool calling demo.
- 2026-02-10: Deep-dive call (Fireflies ff_2026-02-10_77821) — engineering + infra. Discussed latency SLOs and per-tenant quotas.
- 2026-02-18: Pricing + SSO/security call (Fireflies ff_2026-02-18_88342). Shared security FAQ and initial pricing deck.
- Planned: 2-week POC (hosted) to validate streaming stability and implement tenant-level rate limiting; then evaluate Dedicated for TCO and SLO guarantees.

Use-case & requirements (from calls and tech review):
- Primary workload: multi-tenant chat/agent platform with tool calling (external API calls) and streaming responses to end users.
- Scale: ~1000 active tenants at launch, typical tenant concurrency 5-20 users; spike scenarios up to 200 concurrent streams across platform.
- Latency targets: p50 < 150ms token latency for streaming start, p95 < 450ms for token/response segments; end-to-end user-visible latency SLO ~800ms for simple queries.
- Throughput: peak sustained tokens/sec ~20k; want predictable tail latency during multi-tenant spikes.
- Rate limits/quotas: need per-tenant configurable quotas (tokens/min, concurrent streams) + backpressure behaviour and transparent error codes for clients.
- Streaming stability: require no frequent reconnects; want graceful degradation (partial responses) and automatic fallback to non-streaming endpoints if needed.
- Model preferences: open model variants acceptable if latency/cost tradeoffs match; interested in Redwood-verified smaller models for low-latency routing.
- Routing/fallback: prefer policy-based routing (region/cost/latency) and automatic fallback to compatible model variant on overload.

Security & compliance:
- SSO (SAML) required for admin console.
- Audit logs and retention controls needed for customer introspection.
- Data residency: some enterprise tenants may require EU-only hosting; evaluating region routing and Dedicated/private options.
- KMS integration (customer-managed keys) requested for Dedicated phase.

POC plan (high level):
- Week 0: config + onboarding, SSO test account.
- Week 1: run synthetic load for streaming endpoints, capture p50/p95 token latencies, observe reconnect rate, validate function/tool calling under load.
- Week 2: integrate per-tenant quota controls, run multi-tenant burst test, collect logs/traces. Deliver report + recommended Dedicated sizing.

Commercial conversation:
- Interested in hosted for quick time-to-value; will consider Dedicated commit if SLOs/SLA and unit economics are acceptable.
- Initial ARR expectation: $50k-$200k depending on commit and support.

Quotes from contacts:

- "Per-tenant quotas are a must, we can't have noisy neighbors blowing budgets." — Head of Ops (Maya Lin)

- Can you share historical streaming stability metrics under multi-tenant workloads?
- Confirm options for region-restricted Dedicated and KMS integration timelines.
